command:
cd /home/starryreverie/userdata/development/rCore-Tutorial-Code-2026A && set -e
echo "=== ch1 before ===" && git log --oneline -1 ch1
b1=$(git hash-object -w reports/lab1.md)
b2=$(git hash-object -w reports/ch1-gdb.log)
b3=$(git hash-object -w reports/ch1-api-run.log)
echo "blobs: $b1 $b2 $b3"
export GIT_INDEX_FILE=/tmp/ch1-reports-index
rm -f "$GIT_INDEX_FILE"
git read-tree ch1
git update-index --add --cacheinfo 100644,"$b1",reports/lab1.md
git update-index --add --cacheinfo 100644,"$b2",reports/ch1-gdb.log
git update-index --add --cacheinfo 100644,"$b3",reports/ch1-api-run.log
tree=$(git write-tree)
echo "tree: $tree"
commit=$(git commit-tree "$tree" -p ch1 -m "docs(ch1): add lab report and GDB trace log

Copy reports/lab1.md, reports/ch1-gdb.log and reports/ch1-api-run.log from
the ch1-api implementation branch, so the source-analysis report required
for chapter 1 is also present on the ch1 branch.")
echo "commit: $commit"
git update-ref refs/heads/ch1 "$commit"
unset GIT_INDEX_FILE
echo "=== ch1 after ===" && git log --oneline -2 ch1
echo "=== reports tracked on ch1 ===" && git ls-tree -r --name-only ch1 | grep '^reports/'
